fullvendor.card: Ihuriro nyamukuru ryo gucunga no gukwirakwiza.
fullvendor.lead: Hagati yibikorwa byawe byubucuruzi: ibicuruzwa, ibiciro, imigabane nabakiriya ahantu hamwe.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor isimbuza umugabuzi urekuye impapuro na sisitemu. Kuva hano ibicuruzwa bisohoka, kubara birabazwa, portfolio yabakiriya iritabwaho kandi nimero yumunsi irareba. Ibisigaye bya ecosystem ihuza iyi shingiro.

Igurisha n’imari bigomba kureba umukiriya umwe.
Raporo yarengeje iminsi ya buri munsi ifite agaciro karenze gutinda.

legal.privacy_intro: Iyi politiki isobanura ibyo dukora hamwe namakuru wasize muburyo bwuru rubuga.

privacy.title: Ni ayahe makuru dukusanya
privacy.text: Niba usabye demo cyangwa ukatwandikira, tubika izina, isosiyete, imeri, numero ya terefone niba ubigaragaje, igihugu, ingano yikipe, ibicuruzwa byinyungu nubutumwa. Twanditse kandi itariki, imvugo yurupapuro na aderesi ya IP, kugirango twirinde gutanga nabi.

privacy.title: Turabakoresha iki?
privacy.text: Dukoresha aya makuru kugirango tugusubize gusa, duhuze demo kandi dutegure icyifuzo cyubucuruzi. Ntabwo tubagurisha cyangwa ngo tubahe kurutonde rwabandi bantu.

privacy.title: Babikwa he kandi kugeza ryari?
privacy.text: Ibisabwa bibitswe kuri seriveri yuru rubuga. Turabibika mugihe gikenewe cyo kugukorera no gukurikirana ubucuruzi, kandi turabisiba mugihe ubidusabye cyangwa mugihe bitagikenewe.

privacy.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
privacy.text: Urashobora gusaba kwinjira, gukosora cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe kurupapuro rwitumanaho, ukabigaragaza mubutumwa. Niba isosiyete itangaza imeri kururu rubuga, urashobora kandi kwandika hano.

legal.terms_intro: Ibi bisabwa bikurikizwa kumikoreshereze yuru rubuga FullVendor.

terms.title: Amakuru yubucuruzi
terms.text: Inyandiko, urugero igishushanyo mbonera hamwe nibisobanuro byerekana urubuga. Birashobora guhinduka mugihe ibicuruzwa bihindutse kandi ntabwo ari ibintu bifunze.

terms.title: Demo ntabwo ari amasezerano
terms.text: Gutanga ifishi ntibisobanura inshingano yo kugura cyangwa kubika igiciro. Amasezerano ayo ari yo yose yemeranijwe ukwayo, mu nyandiko, hamwe n’ibipimo byayo.

terms.title: Ibirimo kurubuga
terms.text: Ikirango FullVendor ikirango, amazina yibicuruzwa nibiri muriyi page ni ibya nyirabyo. Ntibishobora kwiganwa kugirango berekane ikindi gicuruzwa.

terms.title: Gukoresha byemewe
terms.text: Ntukoreshe impapuro kugirango utange amakuru y'ibinyoma, spam cyangwa ibintu bitemewe. Turashobora kwirengagiza ibyifuzo bidahuye nibiganiro byubucuruzi.
